values: Evidence checkpoint: 24 Oct 2026 | Zindi CSV and NWIC project inventory locally audited; CRS, label permissions, AOI authority and advisory validation remain open.
SRSP Stage I ranks first by current point overlap (147), but it is not a selected or verified AOI. Boundary source authority, vintage, terms and ground-truth quality still need verification.
Layer 18 is a 1,131,404-parcel cadastral dataset. Only 10 parcels around the source points were retrieved; it is not a command boundary.
NWIC independently lists Sriramsagar Stage-I (Pochampad), but its GeoJSON has no CRS declaration and its area field differs from TGRAC; no spatial match is established.
The Zindi CSV is saved and counted, but its CRS/topology/label protocol remain open. No source validates measured moisture stress or irrigation-advisory outcomes.
1. Team/owner: confirm target geography and record AOI/study-period approval.
2. Providers: obtain TGRAC survey/reuse details and I&CAD/NWIC boundary authority, CRS and applicable reuse terms.
3. Member B + WRMS/Zindi: obtain crop-health file CRS and label protocol; assess spatial/date fit and follow CC-BY-SA attribution/share-alike.
4. Member B + Member A: review ICAR calendar and generic FAO-56 Kc references against selected crops/season.
5. Member A: configure Earth Engine project locally; never share credentials.
6. Team/field partners: supply independent moisture and irrigation-event/outcome evidence, or narrow the scientific claim.
